mentions.name: Store Checkout validator (yayauptime.com)
mentions.description: A continuous visual check for web-store checkout flows. It visually checks a store's storefront, product page, cart, and checkout. Currently an MVP aimed at helping medium and low-end store owners with their websites.
mentions.problem: Medium and low-end store owners without a full-time developer lack an easy way to continuously verify that their store's website, product pages, cart, and checkout are working.
mentions.audience: Medium and low-end web-store owners who don't have a full-time developer.
mentions.source_excerpt: Store Checkout validator, a continuous check for web-store checkout. it visually checks store, its product page, cart and checkout. Kind of cool but it's just an MVP to help the medium/low-end store owners with their website. Targeting people who don't a full time developer :)
